question:
Select the option that best defines the given word.

Apportion
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Apportion"** means to allocate or distribute something among individuals or groups. (विभाजित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The manager decided to **apportion **the budget equally among all departments.
 
 
 
• **"Allocate"** refers to assigning or distributing resources or responsibilities for a specific purpose. (आवंटित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The government **allocated **funds for building schools in rural areas.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "**Apportion**" is best defined by "**Allocate**".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To complicate** (जटिल बनाना): To make something more difficult or complex.

 
 
• **Example:** Adding unnecessary details will only **complicate **the problem.
 
 
 
• **To confess** (स्वीकार करना): To admit or acknowledge something, often a wrongdoing.
 
 
• **Example:** He **confessed **to his teacher that he had forgotten to do his homework.
 
 
 
• **To request** (निवेदन करना): To ask for something formally or politely.
 
 
• **Example:** She **requested **a day off to attend her friend's wedding.
 
 

2f:T816,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
